reason: The README describes a configurable subagent system whose primary purpose is orchestrating foreground or background child agents through profiles, with progress visualization and profile management.

summaries.zh: 一个通过可配置 profile 管理和编排前台或后台子代理，并在 Web 界面展示进度与子代理树的插件。
summaries.en: A plugin for orchestrating configurable foreground or background subagents through profiles, with web-based progress and subagent-tree views.

capabilities: spawns configurable foreground or background subagents
allows profile-based model, persona, tool-filter, depth, and execution-mode configuration
persists profiles and exposes profile CRUD through a dedicated RPC channel
displays subagent progress and session trees in a web UI
